notes.title: 2024/1/11Patch
notes.notes:
1.Added a warehouse button for directly viewing and replacing Pokémon, instead of clicking on them in the scene.
2.Fixed a bug causing the leaderboard to freeze.
3.Added frame rate locking.
4.Fixed a bug where sound effects could not be changed.
5.Fixed a bug causing experience balls to get stuck in mid-air and not being absorbed.
6.Optimized some UI interfaces.
7.Memory optimization.

We really appreciate your support! Due to the fact that we are currently developing another game, there won't be new content for this game in the short term. However, we will continue to fix bugs and plan to add some online features in the future. We wish everyone good luck and good health!

1.Increase multiple prompts.
2.When the player enters the "catching Pokémon" state, their attack power will be reduced.
3.Add more detailed beginner tutorials.
4.Add a health bar display above the player's head.
5.Reduce the boss's health.
6.ncrease the experience gained by players in difficulty mode when settling accounts.
More rich content is still under development. For optimization, if the game is lagging, it is recommended to lower the graphics quality and resolution due to my limited technical abilities.

notes.title: Minor repair
notes.notes: Fix the bug that causes the leaderboard to freeze easily and change the leaderboard to pages

notes.title: Fixed some bugs and balanced optimizations.
notes.notes:
"Fixed the bug where resolution debugging malfunctioned."
"Added a button in the settings interface to customize whether to display damage or not."
"Slightly increased the difficulty of Endless Mode."
"Reduced the amount of power gained after successfully catching a sprite."

notes.title: Balance optimization
notes.notes: Cancel the "Q" key for capturing and change it to directly using the left mouse button. Increase the delay cooldown for capturing Pokeballs and reduce the numerical bonus for the "Power Up" option after successfully capturing.
